title: Numerical analysis of the second-order time-dependent saddle point Maxwell system via a parameter-free discontinuous Galerkin method: The first optimal ${\bf L}^{2}$-norm error estimates
summary: We present a novel parameter-free discontinuous Galerkin (dG) finite element method (FEM) for the time-dependent Maxwell system formulated as a saddle point problem. We establish the stability of the proposed semi-discrete problem and derive optimal error estimates in energy and \( {\bf L}^{2} \) norms for the electric field variable, as well as in \( L^{2} \) norm for the potential function. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first optimal \( {\bf L}^{2} \)-norm error analysis for the second-order time-dependent saddle point Maxwell equations using any variants of FEMs.…
